purpose.en: Replace prefix-only sentence levels with a canonical 4,320-item progression for listening, writing, vocabulary, and Daily Sprint word-order practice.
purpose.zh: 以正式的 4,320 条分级句库替换仅加前缀的伪分级，为听力、写作、词汇和今日速成提供挑词组句练习。

en: Provide 120 sentences for every combination of 12 learning languages and three course levels.
Cover 12 real-life scenarios and ten communicative functions in every course.
Progress from A1 survival utterances to A2-B1 reasons and constraints, then B1+-B2 comparison, contingency, and negotiation.
Keep heard-sentence and translated-prompt word matching backed by the same canonical answers.
zh: 十二种学习语言的初、中、高级课程各提供 120 句。
每门课程完整覆盖 12 个生活场景和 10 种沟通任务。
从 A1 生存表达递进到 A2-B1 原因与限制，再到 B1+-B2 比较、应变与协商。
听句组句和看母语提示组句共用同一套标准答案。

en: Add a D1 catalog with 4,320 published, tokenized, versioned sentence rows.
Store level, CEFR alignment, difficulty, usefulness frequency, sequence, scenario, communicative function, bilingual prompts, and answer tokens.
Make database rows exactly mirror the runtime sentence builder used by all word-order interfaces.
zh: 新增包含 4,320 条已发布、已分词、可版本管理句子的 D1 句库。
保存等级、CEFR 对齐、难度、实用常用度、顺序、场景、沟通功能、双语提示和答案词块。
数据库逐条镜像所有挑词组句界面实际使用的运行时句库。

en: Audit all 36 language-level courses for 120 unique rows, 12 scenarios, ten functions, valid tokens, and genuine level progression.
Run TypeScript, the full repository test suite, verified production build, shared-site gates, migration validation, and source checks.
Use real Chrome and Safari after deployment to complete listening and writing word-order questions.
zh: 审计 36 门语言等级课程，确认各有 120 条唯一句子、12 个场景、10 种任务、有效词块和真实等级递进。
执行 TypeScript、完整仓库测试、正式构建、共享站点门禁、迁移验证和源码检查。
发布后使用真实 Chrome 与 Safari 完成听力和写作挑词组句。

en: No sentence-catalog scope is deferred; microphone pronunciation remains a separate browser capability.
zh: 本次句库范围没有延期项目；麦克风发音识别仍属于独立的浏览器能力。

en: This is SmartLingo-specific learning content and does not change other portfolio sites.
zh: 本次为 SmartLingo 专属学习内容，不改变其他站点。
